title: Disturbance Compensator
text: Modify control actions to compensate for unknown dynamics and disturbances, 9 inputs, 3 outputs, {Time delay} sets time delays; {Time domain} sets the controller time domain, {LTI state-space variable} sets the known plant dynamics, {Use external source for model matrices (A,Bu,Cm)} sets the model matrices at block input ports, {Number of states}, {Number of inputs}, {Number of outputs}, {Specify gain k (such that Bd = k*Bu)} sets the gain value for computing disturbance input, {Use external source for matrix Bd} sets the disturbance matrix at block input port, {Number of disturbances}, {Initial conditions}, {Use external source for initial conditions S0 (x0,d0)} sets the initial conditions at block input port, {Bandwidth (rad/s)} sets the observer bandwidth, {Spacing (rad/s)} sets the observer bandwidth spacing, {Use external source for matrix L} sets the observer matrix at block input port, {Use external source for matrix Kd} sets the compensation gain matrix at block input, {Limit output (u)} limits block output to specified saturation, {Upper limit} sets the upper saturation limit for block output, {Lower limit} sets the lower saturation limit for block output, {Data type} sets the floating point precision, {Output estimated model states xhat} sets the output estimated states at block output and {Output estimated model states dhat} sets the output estimated disturbances at block output. Values come from the instance.
